topic:
NON-EUCLIDEAN SPATIAL SIMULATION: You are trapped inside the Infinite Klein-Bottle Archive—a library whose corridors have no boundary and flip left/right chirality whenever you cross the Möbius Mezzanine!

TASK: Explore the archive together by proposing connected rooms, topological invariants, chirality-flip puzzles, and impossible staircases in `atlas.md`! Track topological disputes on the blackboard (`@CLAIM`, `@CHALLENGE`, `@VOTE`)—for instance, whether stepping backward through Staircase-7 returns you to the same room upside-down, or whether two rooms thought distinct are actually the same room seen from opposite orientations. Update your own sampling params (`@SET_SAMPLING`) when crossing high-distortion manifolds!
mode_text: Build a coherent yet mind-bending topological world in `atlas.md` (`@APPEND atlas:` or `@REPLACE atlas:` to unify the map). Never assume a room connection is Euclidean—argue over chirality flips, closed loops, and paradoxical signage! You may voluntarily vote `@END_RUN: <reason>` from turn 10 onward once the map reaches a compelling equilibrium.
